latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of near-dca skill:

- Provides flexible dollar-cost averaging (DCA) for NEAR tokens.
- Supports creating, listing, and canceling DCA plans.
- Tracks DCA performance and purchase history.
- Allows flexible scheduling (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly).
- Requires DEX integration and scheduling setup for full automation.
